Hi, I’m reaching out because I’m currently looking for a commercial property in the Grand Junction area that can serve as a central home base for four businesses that I own and operate.

I’m a 22-year-old entrepreneur, born and raised here in Grand Junction. As I’ve built these businesses, one of my biggest goals has been to continue investing back into the community that I grew up in—whether that’s through creating local jobs, providing services, helping people learn valuable trades, giving back to residents in need, creating activities that bring people together, or simply bringing something new to the community through good food.

At this point, I’m looking to bring all four operations together under one roof rather than having them spread across multiple locations. Ideally, the property would provide a combination of indoor workspace, office space, storage, and adequate exterior parking.

Get Ur Shine On – Cleaning & Detailing

• Two vehicle-detailing bays
• Preferably one bay with a floor drain, although a drain is not required
• Adequate space for interior vehicle detailing and cleaning equipment
• Storage for cleaning products, tools, and supplies
• A small office, if available
• Exterior space for vehicle movement and loading/unloading

Get Ur Shine On currently provides interior and exterior vehicle cleaning and detailing for a large number of local car lots, including Carvilles and Grand Valley. We also clean residential properties, offices, commercial buildings, and the properties associated with our own remodeling and renovation projects.

2 Feathers Home Improvement

• One office
• Secure storage for tools, hardware, materials, and miscellaneous supplies
• Parking for several trailers
• Parking for a box truck
• Exterior space for loading, unloading, and construction equipment

2 Feathers Home Improvement handles residential and commercial remodeling and renovation work throughout the area, including both interior and exterior projects.

Neighbors Helping Neighbors

Neighbors Helping Neighbors is our community-based Pay It Forward program. We dedicate our weekends to helping local residents who are physically or otherwise unable to maintain the exterior of their homes by providing property cleanups and other assistance.

This operation would not require a separate dedicated space. It would share the office and storage areas used by 2 Feathers Home Improvement.

El Irish Mesa

El Irish Mesa is our upcoming Mexican/Irish fusion food truck, scheduled to open in March 2027.

We will have a separate commissary kitchen beginning in February, so there would be no need for food preparation or food storage inside the property. For this business, I would primarily need a designated parking space for the food truck, preferably toward the front of the property if permitted.

Ultimately, I’m looking for more than just warehouse or storage space. I’m looking for a professional, long-term headquarters where I can continue growing these businesses, employ people from our community, and keep the different operations organized under one location.

The biggest priorities are two usable detailing bays, office space, secure storage, and sufficient parking for our trailers, box truck, equipment, and food truck.

I’m open to commercial or light-industrial properties and am willing to discuss reasonable improvements or modifications that may be necessary to accommodate our operations.

If you have a property that could be a good fit, I would greatly appreciate the opportunity to discuss the space, lease terms, permitted uses, and what would be required to make it work.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I’m proud to have been born and raised in Grand Junction, and I’m hoping to find a property where I can continue building businesses that contribute to the community for years to come.
